otp.sent: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It expires in 10 minutes.
otp.resent: We sent a new code to {email}.
otp.enterCodeFor: Enter the 6-digit code we emailed to {email}. Check your spam folder if you can't find it.
otp.codeHint: Only the most recent code works.

errors.invalid_email: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.invalid_code_format: Enter the 6 digits from the email.
errors.invalid: That code isn't right. Please check it and try again.
errors.expired: That code has expired. Send a new code and try again.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many wrong attempts. Please send a new code.
errors.rate_limited: A code was sent very recently. Please use it, or wait a little before asking for a new one.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.send_failed: We couldn't send the email right now. Please try again in a few minutes.

OAuthAccountNotLinked.title: This email is already registered
OAuthAccountNotLinked.body: An account with this email already exists and uses a different sign-in method. Please sign in the way you did originally (for example with an email code), then link this method from Settings.

AccessDenied.title: Sign-in was not allowed
AccessDenied.body: We couldn't sign you in with that account. If you used Google, make sure its email address is verified, or sign in with an email code instead.

Verification.title: This link or code is no longer valid
Verification.body: It may have expired or already been used. Please start signing in again.

Configuration.title: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable
Configuration.body: There is a problem on our side. Please try again later, or sign in with a different method.

OAuthCallbackError.title: Sign-in was cancelled
OAuthCallbackError.body: The sign-in with the provider didn't complete. Please try again.

OAuthSignin.title: Couldn't start sign-in
OAuthSignin.body: We couldn't reach the sign-in provider. Please try again, or sign in with a different method.

CredentialsSignin.title: Couldn't sign you in
CredentialsSignin.body: The code wasn't accepted. Please request a new code and try again.

MissingCSRF.title: Your session expired
MissingCSRF.body: Please reload the page and try again.

Default.title: Couldn't sign you in
Default.body: Something went wrong while signing in. Please try again.
